  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add weapons to the existing NEON RUNNER game and keep it playable.

## Requirements
- Build the requested change without asking clarifying questions.
- Save screenshot checks as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Added three selectable weapons: NEEDLE, BURST, and PRISM.
- Shots automatically aim at the nearest pulse; otherwise they follow movement or fire upward.
- Weapons can destroy pulses and award points.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added keyboard firing (`F`), weapon cycling (`Q`), direct selection (`1`–`3`), mouse/touch firing, and a mobile FIRE button.
- Added weapon display, projectile rendering, pulse destruction, sound cues, and brief firing instructions.
- Verified inline JavaScript syntax, `git diff --check`, and weapon cycling in Chromium.
- Saved and inspected `/tmp/opencode/weapons-game.jpg` at mobile and desktop viewport sizes.

### Active
- Final review of the modified game code.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run final syntax and diff checks after the latest pause/blur changes.
2. Confirm the working tree status and report the change; changes are uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the NEON RUNNER game and all weapon changes.

## Important Context
- Work is uncommitted; only `index.html` has been modified.
- Browser console showed only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404.
